children: rose 3.81% in premarket trading after it amended its $1.4 billion convertible notes exchange to settle roughly 27% of the consideration in cash. Noteholders now receive about 55.5 million shares plus approximately $358.4 million, funded from cash on hand. The original terms priced the exchange off a 35 trading day volume-weighted average reference period that started August 3, which left the final share count unknown while the stock traded. That window is now terminated. No additional shares are issuable, and the exchange should close on or about September 3.

The company also announced preliminary second quarter figures. Operating income is expected between $150 million and $170 million, against $66.4 million a year earlier, on net sales of $780 million to $800 million versus $972.2 million. Net income lands between $290 million and $310 million, carried by roughly $238 million of net gains on the eBay Inc.

position and dented by a $75 million loss on digital assets. GameStop attributed the sales decline to last year's Nintendo Switch 2 launch, planned store closures, and the divestiture of its France operations.

The balance sheet is the harder read. Cash, equivalents and marketable securities dropped to roughly $5.06 billion from $8.694 billion after GameStop converted its eBay derivative into 43.4 million shares worth about $4.947 billion. Most of its liquidity now sits in a company whose board rejected GameStop's takeover offer as neither credible nor attractive.

title: GameStop Doubles Operating Income on Sharply Lower Sales
